newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Snia Fibre, Snia Bpd to merge.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Snia Fibre, Snia Bpd to merge.

text.p: Italian chemical company Snia Fibre is to be merged into Snia BPD, both part of the Fiat SpA group, a statement from Fiat said.
Snia Bpd currently controls 83.68 percent of the capital of Snia Fibre, the statement said.
"The boards of Snia Fibre and Snia BPD have decided to start the process of a project to merge the first company into the second," the statement said.
It said Ernst and Young would assist in assessing the swap ratio for the operation on the basis of economic and equity criteria and on stock market values.
The project would be examined by the two boards in March when they approved the results for 1996.
